messages:
PagerDutyBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-prod (route: /v1/generate). Error rate spike started ~5m ago. 20% 5xx, primarily 502/503. Pager: pagerduty.com/incident/RED-2312
Sam (oncall): ack. I'm on it.
Maya (infra): seeing a cascade of model-runner exits on the GPU pool. OOM + segfaults in the logs. attaching snippet:
```
Jun 12 03:21:14 runner-12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 14233 (model-runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
Jun 12 03:21:14 model-runner[14233]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8b6... sp 0x7ffd9... error 4 in libquant.so[7f8b600000+1a000]
Stacktrace: <snip>
```
Sam (oncall): hmm, confirm segfault in libquant + OOM. Probably memory leak or batch size spike. Is there any traffic change?
Maya (infra): traffic looks normal but token lengths spiked from a monitoring job hitting long-history prompts. median seq_len went from 128 to 1024 for ~2% of requests. Batching combined those -> memory blowout.
Eli (sre): I'm going to reduce max batch size on the pool and enable per-request seq cap. Running command now: `rwdctl pool update gpu-pool --max-batch 4`
Sam (oncall): good. Also enable routing fallback to smaller model variant `redwood-small-v2` for 10% traffic. Command: `rwdctl route set /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood-small-v2 --fallback-weight 10`
DeployBot: Rollout started: route update -> 10% fallback.
Sam (oncall): triggering a drain on the most noisy nodes to force new processes without the bad lib loaded: `rwdctl nodes drain runner-12,runner-15`
Maya (infra): doing a rolling restart of model-runner on drained hosts. watching memory.
CustomerSuccess: any idea on impacted customers? we have one large customer hitting production for chatbots. need ETA for status update.
Sam (oncall): early numbers: ~3% of requests from top-ten customers saw 5xx during the window. A few timed out and retried; some failed permanently. Suggest we send interim note: "We are investigating elevated errors on inference; mitigation in progress."
Jules (ops-lead): agreed. CS send holding note and mention route fallback + throttling.
Eli (sre): after reducing batch and gating seq_len to 512, OOMs stopped on most hosts. Error rate dropped from 20% -> 4% in ~6 minutes.
Sam (oncall): logs show one reproducible crash path in libquant when `seq_len * batch > 4096` on that quantized kernel. Filing bug: QK-527.
Maya (infra): temporary mitigations applied: max-batch 4, seq cap 512, 10% fallback to redwood-small-v2, drained 6 hosts and restarted model-runner.
Sam (oncall): handoff time in 15m. I'm going to prepare a concise incident summary for the on-call log.
Sam (oncall): INCIDENT_SUMMARY DRAFT:
- Detection: PagerDuty alert - elevated 5xx on inference-gateway-prod (3126794321)
- Impact: peak 20% 5xx; ~3% of requests from top customers affected; retries mitigated some errors
- Cause: model-runner crashes (OOM + segfault) under high effective memory usage when long sequences were batched together against quantized kernel (libquant)
- Mitigation: reduced pool max-batch to 4, enforced seq cap 512, rolled 10% traffic to fallback smaller model, drained and restarted affected nodes
- Status: error rate reduced to ~4%, service degrading but stable. Monitoring for regressions.
Jules (ops-lead): good. I'll take follow-up and own postmortem. Sam, handoff to me at 03:40 UTC. Full incident owner: Jules.
Sam (oncall): handing off. My notes + commands run:
```
# commands executed
rwdctl pool update gpu-pool --max-batch 4
rwdctl route set /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood-small-v2 --fallback-weight 10
rwdctl nodes drain runner-12,runner-15,runner-20
```
Sam (oncall): leaving a watch on monitoring, reachable if needed.
Jules (ops-lead): taking over. Next steps: schedule emergency deploy to revert recent quantized kernel changes in libquant to stable build, and create a temporary request-level limiter for sequences >512 to avoid recurrence. Also coordinate with Research for kernel fix.
DeployBot: Deploy queued: revert/libquant-stable -> canary 5%
Maya (infra): starting canary revert on 2 nodes.
CustomerSuccess: sending customer note now: "We experienced elevated errors earlier; mitigation in place. We'll share timeline and root cause after full investigation."
Eli (sre): monitoring graphs: 5xx back to baseline ~0.8% after canary and node restarts. Will keep 2h elevated retention for traces.
Jules (ops-lead): assigning postmortem owner: Jules. Timeline and action items will be in incident ticket RED-2312.
Sam (oncall): thanks team. leaving the channel.
Jules (ops-lead): final status update (03:45 UTC): service stable, mitigation in place. We'll keep the fallback and seq cap until kernel fix deployed. Creating follow-up: - permanent throttling guard - kernel patch - better batching heuristics - automated seq cap when quantized kernels in use
CustomerSuccess: thanks. We'll update affected customers with the ETA for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
